# OAuth option visibility reads the input being edited rather than a cached hostname

Current incoming/outgoing OAuth visibility code sanitizes the current hostname input. Incoming Exchange configuration derives it from the typed URL. Comments explain that an invalid newly typed hostname can leave a cached valid hostname behind. The option is reset when OAuth is not supported. Preserve this direct input boundary when refactoring validation; checking only the cached config can show an option for the previous server. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
